_comment: Hosts the built-in /_next/image optimizer may fetch. Single source of truth: next.config.ts builds images.remotePatterns from this list and src/lib/cloudinary/image-loader.ts uses it to decide which https images are handed to the optimizer versus straight to the browser. Kept outside src/ on purpose (the storefront guard forbids stock/placeholder host names inside src). '*.' matches exactly one DNS label.
